lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: First dive's always the ugliest, Cipher. You're back on the table, and that's the part that counts.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Easy. I pulled you out of the Fracture once, I'll do it again. The rig's still warm, and so am I.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Six years ago you spared me when the book said don't. Least I can do is stitch you up twice.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Breathe. Everybody dies the first time down there. Most just don't wake up on a salvager's table after.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Rustfang chews up better fighters than you. Gryph's old hold is carved into those caves. Learn the pits.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Coil blades in the dark, Cipher. Watch your flanks first, the front will take care of itself.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Rust took you. Fine. It takes everybody on the first pass. Sit down, drink something, go again.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You were still counting exits when they closed. Don't count. Listen for the edge.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Program built that place to erase you, Cipher. Don't walk its halls like you belong there.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cold rooms, clean lines, no mercy. That's the Program talking. Answer it with your own pace.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Their guards swing like they were taught. Because they were. Find the rhythm, then break it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I've seen what the Program does to operatives. Don't hand it a second sample of you. Go again.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Silent Garden gets in your head. Khall's grief took root in there too. Don't let it take yours.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You made it to the Garden. That's further than most. The last stretch is the one that bites.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Quiet down there, isn't it. Too quiet. Hear the bloom before it hears you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: One more breath, Cipher. The Garden doesn't hate you. It just doesn't care. Make it care.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You closed it, Cipher. The Fracture's quiet. I'm not ashamed to say I held my breath the whole way.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Maelgorn's machine stalled for a day. The war is the product, and you just broke the line. Good work.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Iris would have loved to see that. Hell, so would I. Come aboard, the rig is lit up like a festival.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Mercy as rebellion. That's what you do, Cipher. Rest now. The Cairn has your back.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: With the heat turned all the way up? The Synod will feel that one in its ledgers, Cipher.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Hardest run I've watched, and you walked off it. The Ten Syndicates can keep their wars. We keep you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You paid the full price and came out standing. Save some luck for the next dive.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's not a run, that's a statement. The Cairn is still ringing. Somebody tell Velorum.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: I keep the gate, operative. Nobody crosses the Rustfang without my leave.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: The gate does not break, and neither do I. Come, feel the weight of it.

lines.speaker: Vane
lines.text: Operative detected. Designation Ronin. Return to the Program, or be erased.

lines.speaker: Vane
lines.text: Erasure incomplete. Switching to pursuit.

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: You are a weapon I allowed to wander, Ronin-7. War is a harvest, and you are late to it.

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: Mercy is a tax I have never paid. Let me collect it from you.

lines.speaker: Maelgorn
lines.text: Ten syndicates, a thousand wars, and you think one blade ends it? Then end it, Soren.
